summary: The Zcash ETF, a Delaware trust sponsored by Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, filed a Form 8-K reporting completion of a 3-for-1 forward share split effected by the sponsor prior to the open on NYSE Arca on September 30, 2026. Holders of record at the close on September 28, 2026 received two additional shares per pre-split share after the close on September 29. Shares outstanding rose from 7,989,300 to 23,967,900; NAV per share fell from $111.41 to $37.14. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply; the split is value-neutral and the CUSIP and ZCSH ticker are unchanged.
